description: Commercially useful ClinicalTrials.gov probe domains for expanding CKG vs RAG vs GraphRAG validation beyond GLP-1. This is a pragmatic top-12 target set for trial-intelligence buyers, not a live-ranked ClinicalTrials.gov volume report.

domains.label: Oncology - solid tumors
domains.rationale: Highest-value clinical-trial intelligence market; strong need for line-of-therapy, biomarker, endpoint, and comparator context.

domains.label: Hematologic malignancies
domains.rationale: Dense trial activity across myeloma, leukemia, lymphoma, cell therapy, bispecifics, and MRD endpoints.

domains.label: Cardiovascular disease
domains.rationale: Large outcomes-trial market with complex endpoint, risk-factor, device, and comorbidity relationships.

domains.label: Neurology and neurodegeneration
domains.rationale: High ambiguity around disease staging, endpoints, biomarkers, and trial inclusion criteria.

domains.label: Immunology and autoimmune disease
domains.rationale: Commercially active biologics/JAK/TYK2 space with reusable pathways, endpoints, and population definitions.

domains.label: Infectious disease and vaccines
domains.rationale: Broad trial landscape where status, population, strain/variant, prophylaxis, and endpoint context matter.

domains.label: Metabolic and endocrine disease
domains.rationale: Adjacent to GLP-1 with strong payer, outcomes, endpoint, and comorbidity structure.

domains.label: Rare and genetic disease
domains.rationale: Strong fit for source-grounded context because patient populations, mutations, endpoints, and eligibility are specialized.

domains.label: Respiratory and pulmonary disease
domains.rationale: Large condition set with devices, biologics, symptom scores, exacerbation outcomes, and imaging/functional endpoints.

domains.label: Gastroenterology and hepatology
domains.rationale: Strong overlap between immune disease, metabolic disease, liver disease, biomarkers, and histologic endpoints.

domains.label: Nephrology and renal disease
domains.rationale: Good fit for outcome-chain reasoning across CKD, diabetic kidney disease, transplant, endpoints, and comorbid risk.

domains.label: Psychiatry and behavioral health
domains.rationale: Difficult trial-intelligence domain because endpoints, scales, comorbidities, and eligibility criteria are highly textual.
